name: hairline-adopt
description: Use when someone has an SVG (an icon, a logo, an illustration) and wants it as a Hairline figure, or runs /hairline-adopt with a file. Reads the drawing, rebuilds its object as an isometric line figure on the engine of @lucasmarkes/hairline, and gives it a gesture that answers the pointer.

name: hairline-create
description: Use when someone asks for a new Hairline figure, or runs /hairline-create with an idea. Draws one isometric line figure that answers the pointer, in the style and on the engine of @lucasmarkes/hairline, and hands it over as a single self-contained HTML file.
